notes.title: UPDATE: Fixing the crash handler
notes.notes: Today's update fixes our crash handler to point to a new URL. Nothing else should have changed.

notes.title: UPDATE: Minor solitaire improvements
notes.notes: Today's update adds an achievement for winning a game of solitaire on expert difficulty and a new sound effect for completing a stack of cards.

notes.title: UPDATE: Typos, small fixes
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of tpyos in the script and emails.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause magenta lines at the edge of the screen.
[*] Fixed a crash that only affected certain window resolutions.
[*] Changed the logic for controller deadzones to (hopefully) fix some controller issues.
[/list]
